I replied to Tobias in your DM: his standing call with the Marrow Agrisupply team is Thursdays at 10:45. That's what he told me on 14 Oct, and the saved note still says the same. He didn't give a time zone, so I mentioned he was writing at UTC−5 that day.

The memory index now also lists Dana Okafor's Quarrendon call. Dana told me that in a direct message, so I left it out of my reply to Tobias.
